scored.contextMeaning: a scored grammar check gives you a final score
scored.sentence: This page is a scored grammar check, not a reading article.
scored.example: The test is scored after you finish.

grammar check.contextMeaning: this page checks A2 grammar skills
grammar check.sentence: This page is a scored grammar check, not a reading article.
grammar check.example: Take the grammar check and review your mistakes.

clue.simpleMeaning: a hint that helps you choose
clue.contextMeaning: a word like yesterday or two helps you choose the answer
clue.sentence: Read the whole sentence, find the clue, choose one answer, and check your score at the end.
clue.example: Yesterday is a clue for past tense.

multiple-choice.simpleMeaning: choosing one answer from several choices
multiple-choice.contextMeaning: each test item has four choices and one best answer
multiple-choice.sentence: The questions follow a common multiple-choice test shape.

present verb forms.simpleMeaning: verb shapes for now or habits
present verb forms.contextMeaning: choose play or plays from the subject
present verb forms.sentence: Some questions test present verb forms.

past time.contextMeaning: words like yesterday and last night need past verbs
past time.example: I saw a movie last night.

prepositions.simpleMeaning: small words for time or place
prepositions.contextMeaning: at, on, and in show time or place relationships
prepositions.example: At nine. On Monday. In April.

comparatives.contextMeaning: use easier than or more interesting than
comparatives.example: This question is easier than the last one.

weak targets.contextMeaning: the score panel shows grammar points you missed
weak targets.sentence: After the test, look at your weak targets.
weak targets.example: Past tense is my weak target today.
weak targets.translationJa: 復習が必要なポイント
